nodes.name: adult Ir56d neuron of labellar taste bristle

edges.citation: Tauber et al. 2017, PLOS Genet 13:e1007059 (IR56d subset of sweet-sensing Gr64f GRNs; posterior projections overlap sweet SEZ region); Brown et al. 2021, eLife 67878.
edges.note: Hypothesized: bristle IR56d GRNs are sweet-sensing GRNs projecting to the same posterior SEZ region; predicted to contact the same second-order interneurons. Individual Ir56d->adult zorro subesophageal neuron synapses are NOT measured.

behavior: Medium-chain fatty acids activate bristle IR56d GRNs (a subset of sweet-sensing neurons); predicted to drive the sweet second-order SEZ circuit and proboscis extension.
fly_narration: HYPOTHESIS: the fat taste rides the sweet road into the brain.
honest_note: PROVENANCE SPLIT — read before using. Hop 0 (FBbt_00048015, bristle IR56d GRN) -> hop 1 (zorro/clavicle/FMIn/fuchs/G2N-1/billiards): LITERATURE-HYPOTHESIS. Grounded in: (1) IR56d neurons are a subset of sweet-sensing Gr64f GRNs, necessary/sufficient for medium-chain FA PER (Tauber et al. 2017); (2) their posterior bristle projections overlap the sweet-sensing SEZ region (Tauber et al. 2017; Brown et al. 2021). The prediction is that they contact the same named second-order SEZ interneurons that sweet GRNs drive. NO individual Ir56d->interneuron synapse is measured anywhere — this is a testable prediction for future connectomic verification, not a wiring claim. Hop 1 -> hop 2 edges are REAL FlyWire v783 rows. REMAINING GAP: the taste-peg E409 IR56d population (FBbt_00048014, anterior SEZ projections) has NO literature-named and NO API-indexed downstream — unmapped in both. Do not present hypothesis edges as measured wiring.
